trigger.customDuration:
function()
    local absorb = UnitGetTotalAbsorbs("player") or 0
    local max = aura_env.maxAbsorb or absorb
    return absorb, max, true
end
trigger.custom:
function()
    if UnitGetTotalAbsorbs then
        local absorb = UnitGetTotalAbsorbs("player")
        if absorb and absorb > 0 then
            if not aura_env.maxAbsorb or absorb > aura_env.maxAbsorb then
                aura_env.maxAbsorb = absorb
            end
            return true
        end
    end
    
    aura_env.maxAbsorb = nil
    return false
end

Absorb Shield Amount.customText:
function()
    if UnitGetTotalAbsorbs then
        local absorb = UnitGetTotalAbsorbs("player") or 0
        return absorb
    end
    return 0
end

trigger.custom:
function()
    local units = {"player", "party1", "party2", "party3", "party4"}
    
    for _, unit in ipairs(units) do
        -- Only check players who exist, are online, and are near you
        if UnitExists(unit) and UnitIsConnected(unit) then
            if unit == "player" or UnitIsVisible(unit) then
                
                -- Standard Whispers
                local hasNzoth = select(11, UnitBuff(unit, "Whispers of N'Zoth")) == 561386 or UnitBuff(unit, "Whispers of N'Zoth")
                local hasYshaarj = select(11, UnitBuff(unit, "Whispers of Y'shaarj")) == 561390 or UnitBuff(unit, "Whispers of Y'shaarj")
                local hasCThun = select(11, UnitBuff(unit, "Whispers of C'Thun")) == 572791 or UnitBuff(unit, "Whispers of C'Thun")
                
                -- Greater Whispers
                local hasGNzoth = UnitBuff(unit, "Greater Whispers of N'Zoth") or UnitBuff(unit, "Greater Whispers of N'zoth")
                local hasGYshaarj = UnitBuff(unit, "Greater Whispers of Y'shaarj")
                local hasGCThun = UnitBuff(unit, "Greater Whispers of C'Thun") or UnitBuff(unit, "Greater Whispers of C'thun")
                
                -- Combined checks
                local activeNzoth = hasNzoth or hasGNzoth
                local activeYshaarj = hasYshaarj or hasGYshaarj
                local activeCThun = hasCThun or hasGCThun
                
                -- Pop up the reminder if they are right next to you but missing all 3
                if not (activeNzoth or activeYshaarj or activeCThun) then
                    return true 
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function()
    local p1 = UnitBuff("player", "Presence of N'Zoth")
    local p2 = UnitBuff("player", "Presence of Yogg-Saron")
    local p3 = UnitBuff("player", "Presence of C'Thun")
    local p4 = UnitBuff("player", "Presence of Y'Shaarj")
    if not (p1 or p2 or p3 or p4) then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

function()
    -- Standard Whispers
    local p1 = UnitBuff("player", "Whispers of N'Zoth") or UnitBuff("player", "Whispers of N'zoth")
    local p2 = UnitBuff("player", "Whispers of Yogg-Saron")
    local p3 = UnitBuff("player", "Whispers of C'Thun") or UnitBuff("player", "Whispers of C'thun")
    local p4 = UnitBuff("player", "Whispers of Y'Shaarj") or UnitBuff("player", "Whispers of Y'shaarj")
    
    -- Greater Whispers
    local gp1 = UnitBuff("player", "Greater Whispers of N'Zoth") or UnitBuff("player", "Greater Whispers of N'zoth")
    local gp2 = UnitBuff("player", "Greater Whispers of Yogg-Saron")
    local gp3 = UnitBuff("player", "Greater Whispers of C'Thun") or UnitBuff("player", "Greater Whispers of C'thun")
    local gp4 = UnitBuff("player", "Greater Whispers of Y'Shaarj") or UnitBuff("player", "Greater Whispers of Y'shaarj")
    
    -- Triggers true if missing ALL standard AND greater whispers
    if not (p1 or p2 or p3 or p4 or gp1 or gp2 or gp3 or gp4) then
        return true
    end
    
    return false
end

function(event, unit, spellName)
    -- Get the exact localized name of your custom spell ID
    local targetSpell = GetSpellInfo(520326)
    
    -- If the player sent a cast for this spell, trigger instantly
    if unit == "player" and spellName == targetSpell then
        return true
    end
end

Shadow of the Void.customText:
function()
    if aura_env.charges and aura_env.charges > 0 and UnitBuff("player", "Eldritch Eye") then
        return tostring(aura_env.charges)
    else
        return ""
    end
end
